description: Complete original favorable-WL development configuration; includes every architecture and all three measurement seeds.
method_definition: Frozen D plus deterministic weak joint layer/XY edit; always use weak candidate, no learned scorer selection.

designs.lineage: OpenCores pipelined_fft_64, Unicore Systems, top USFFT64_2B. Fixed VTR arithmetic/open_cores processed snapshot. Complex FFT datapath and storage.
OpenCores verilog_cordic_core, Volder iterative trigonometric core. Fixed VTR arithmetic/open_cores processed snapshot. Shift/add datapath distinct from the FFT source.

architectures.Z1: concentrated center patch with matched total vertical supply

model.weights_origin: Previously trained009X weights plus010 strict capacity decoder; epoch_0000 records decoder migration, not an untrained random network.

weak_generation.xy_update: 0.15 toward the weighted neighbor centroid clipped to the target leaf; per-axis displacement bounded by 0.15 times leaf span

backend.patch_scope: Shared layer-heterogeneity v2 correctness fixes, XYZ warm-start and observation hooks; layer prior disabled.
backend.pipeline: AP XYZ initialization -> native GP -> APPack -> detailed annealer -> route -> analysis

averaging: Arithmetic seed means within each condition, geometric means across four architectures, equal-weight geometric mean across independent families; negative percent change is improvement.

artifact_policy.replay: Use original retained inputs and exact per-run command/env in a new work directory; preserve archive outputs read-only.

later_retest.interpretation: Historical configuration reference, not a claim that the favorable three-seed WL effect is stable on new seeds.
